'''''Post 1''''' was a [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|''Delta''-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It fought at the [[Recapture of Outpost D-34|Second Battle of Javin]]. Carrying a small amount of equipment that was presumably stolen from [[Outpost D-34]], the shuttle, along with ''[[Post 2]]'', was destroyed by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Fogger]]''.
